<!--
Task:   Identify the supersharers of untrustworthy and trustworthy news and compare their
        emotion features with other users.
Input:  data/Austria-Panel-Users-Daily.csv.gz
        data/Austria-Panel-Users-Features-Tweet-<lang>.csv
Output: data/Austria-Panel-Supersharers.csv, data/Austria-Panel-Supersharers-Groups.csv
        output/figures/supersharers_cdf.pdf, supersharers_emotion_comparison.pdf
        scripts/analysis/users/*.png
Run:    As R Markdown or in terminal as Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("11-analyze_supersharers.Rmd")'   # variants: LANG, DISGUST in the paths chunk
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, 
                      warning = FALSE, 
                      message = FALSE, 
                      fig.width = 6.5,
                      fig.height = 4.5)
set.seed(123)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}
```

```{r paths}
src <- "../../data"
dst <- "../../output"
dir.create(file.path(dst, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("./users", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

LANG <- "de_en"   # de_en (main), de (SI)
DISGUST <- FALSE    # FALSE (main), TRUE (robustness: + disgust panel; validation failed)
EMOTIONS <- c("anger", "fear", if (DISGUST) "disgust")
tag <- if (LANG == "de_en") "" else paste0("-", LANG)
ftag <- paste0(tag, if (DISGUST) "-disgust" else "")  # figures only; the supersharer csv does not depend on it
```

## User data
```{r}
users <- read_csv(file.path(src, "Austria-Panel-Users-Daily.csv.gz"),
                     col_types = cols(
                        author_id = col_character(),
                        day = col_character(),
                        .default = col_double())
                      ) 
nrow(users)
```

```{r}
features <- read_csv(file.path(src, paste0("Austria-Panel-Users-Features-Tweet-", LANG, ".csv")),
                     col_types = cols(
                        author_id = col_character(),
                        .default = col_double())
                      )

features$shares_news <- as.integer(features$n_news_shared > 0)
features$shares_biased <- as.integer(features$n_biased_shared > 0)
features$shares_untrustworthy <- as.integer(features$n_untrustworthy_shared > 0)
```

# ===== CONCENTRATION ANALYSIS =====
```{r}
# get total number of misinfo shared per user per day
users_summary <- users %>%
  group_by(author_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_misinfo_count = sum(n_untrustworthy, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_trustworthy_count = sum(n_trustworthy, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_news_count = sum(n_news, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_biased_count = sum(n_biased, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
  
head(users_summary,2)
```

```{r}
untrustworthy_by_user <- users_summary %>%
  dplyr:::select(author_id, total_misinfo_count) %>%  
  arrange(desc(total_misinfo_count), as.numeric(author_id)) %>%  # ties: by author_id (anonymized IDs keep the order of the original IDs)
  mutate(
    cumsum_count = cumsum(total_misinfo_count),
    cumsum_prop = cumsum_count / sum(total_misinfo_count),
    user_rank = row_number(),
    percentile = user_rank / n() * 100,
    source_type = "Untrustworthy"
  )

threshold_untrustworthy <- min(which(untrustworthy_by_user$cumsum_prop >= 0.80))
percentile_untrustworthy <- untrustworthy_by_user$percentile[threshold_untrustworthy]
untrustworthy_supersharers <- untrustworthy_by_user %>%
  slice(1:threshold_untrustworthy)
```

```{r}
trustworthy_by_user <- users_summary %>%
  dplyr:::select(author_id, total_trustworthy_count) %>%  
  filter(total_trustworthy_count > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_trustworthy_count), as.numeric(author_id)) %>%  # ties: by author_id (anonymized IDs keep the order of the original IDs)
  mutate(
    cumsum_count = cumsum(total_trustworthy_count),
    cumsum_prop = cumsum_count / sum(total_trustworthy_count),
    user_rank = row_number(),
    percentile = user_rank / n() * 100,
    source_type = "Trustworthy"
  )

threshold_trustworthy <- min(which(trustworthy_by_user$cumsum_prop >= 0.80))
percentile_trustworthy <- trustworthy_by_user$percentile[threshold_trustworthy]

trustworthy_supersharers <- trustworthy_by_user %>%
  slice(1:threshold_trustworthy)
```


```{r}
users_combined <- bind_rows(untrustworthy_by_user, trustworthy_by_user)

# plot cumulative distribution
p_cd <- ggplot(users_combined, 
                aes(x = percentile, 
                    y = cumsum_prop,
                    color = source_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, 
              linetype = "dashed", 
              color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Trustworthy" = "#2a9d8f", 
               "Untrustworthy" = "#8b7ab8")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "users (%)",
    y = "news shared (%)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  custom_plot()+
  # adjust legend position to be bottom right corner
  theme(legend.position = c(0.85, 0.1))+
  #annotation with number of users sharing 80% of misinfo
  annotate("text", 
           x = 15, y = 0.83,
           label = paste0(round(percentile_untrustworthy, 2), "% vs ", round(percentile_trustworthy, 2), "% of users"),
           size = 4,
           hjust = 0)

ggsave(paste0("users/supersharers_cdf", tag, ".png"),
       plot = p_cd,
       width = 6.5, height = 4)

ggsave(file.path(dst, "figures", paste0("supersharers_cdf", tag, ".pdf")),
       plot = p_cd,
       width = 6.5, height = 4)
```


# ===== SUPERSHARER ANALYSIS =====

```{r}
# supersharer groups by news sharing only (all users, no emotion features required),
# for the reply network comparison (12d-analyze_replies.Rmd)
supersharer_groups <- bind_rows(
  untrustworthy_supersharers %>% transmute(author_id, group = "Untrustworthy"),
  trustworthy_supersharers %>% transmute(author_id, group = "Trustworthy"))
count(supersharer_groups, group)
write_csv(supersharer_groups, file.path(src, "Austria-Panel-Supersharers-Groups.csv"))
```

```{r}
# get the ppl sharing 80% of misinfo
# and add their features
untrustworthy_supersharers <- untrustworthy_supersharers %>%
  inner_join(features, by = "author_id") %>%
  mutate(group = "Untrustworthy")

# get people who are the supersharers of trustworthy info
trustworthy_supersharers <- trustworthy_supersharers %>%
  inner_join(features, by = "author_id") %>%
  mutate(group = "Trustworthy")

supersharers <- bind_rows(untrustworthy_supersharers, trustworthy_supersharers)
nrow(supersharers)

# supersharers in total vs. with emotion features (enough classified German or English
# tweets); reported with Fig. 1c
left_join(count(supersharer_groups, group, name = "n_all"),
          count(supersharers, group, name = "n_with_features"), by = "group") %>%
  mutate(pct_with_features = round(100 * n_with_features / n_all, 1))
```
```{r}
# save as csv 
write_csv(supersharers, 
          file.path(src, paste0("Austria-Panel-Supersharers", tag, ".csv")))
```
```{r}
# long format per emotion: baseline, variability, instability, inertia
emo_data <- map_dfr(EMOTIONS, function(e) {
  supersharers %>%
    dplyr::select(author_id, group, all_of(paste0(e, c("_baseline", "_variability",
                                                       "_instability", "_inertia")))) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(author_id, group), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(sub(paste0(e, "_"), "", metric),
                           levels = c("baseline", "variability", "instability", "inertia")),
           metric_label = tools::toTitleCase(as.character(metric)),
           emotion = e)
}) %>% filter(is.finite(value))

emo_stats <- emo_data %>%
  group_by(emotion, group, metric, metric_label) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_value = mean(value), std_value = sd(value), .groups = "drop")
print(emo_stats, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Wilcoxon rank-sum tests: trustworthy vs. untrustworthy supersharers
all_tests <- emo_data %>%
  group_by(emotion, metric_label) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value[group == "Trustworthy"],
                                  value[group == "Untrustworthy"])$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(significance = case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                  p_value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"))
print(all_tests)
```

```{r}
group_colors <- c("Untrustworthy" = "#8b7ab8", "Trustworthy" = "#1b9e77")

group_sizes <- supersharers %>% count(group)
legend_mapping <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n=%s)", group_sizes$group, scales::comma(group_sizes$n)),
                           group_sizes$group)

# density peaks to place the significance stars
emo_peaks <- emo_data %>%
  group_by(emotion, metric_label, group) %>%
  summarise(peak_y = max(density(value)$y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(emotion, metric_label) %>%
  summarise(peak_y = max(peak_y), .groups = "drop")

emo_stars <- all_tests %>%
  left_join(emo_stats %>% dplyr::select(emotion, metric_label, group, mean_value) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = mean_value),
            by = c("emotion", "metric_label")) %>%
  left_join(emo_peaks, by = c("emotion", "metric_label")) %>%
  mutate(x = pmax(Trustworthy, Untrustworthy) + 0.01, y = peak_y * 0.99, label = significance)

emotion_panel <- function(e, title, legend = FALSE) {
  st <- emo_stats %>% filter(emotion == e)
  ggplot(emo_data %>% filter(emotion == e), aes(x = value, fill = group, color = group)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(data = st, aes(xintercept = mean_value, color = group),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = st %>% filter(group == "Untrustworthy"),
              aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("M=", round(mean_value, 3))),
              vjust = 1.3, hjust = 2.2, size = 3, color = group_colors["Untrustworthy"],
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = st %>% filter(group == "Trustworthy"),
              aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("M=", round(mean_value, 3))),
              vjust = 2.9, hjust = 2.2, size = 3, color = group_colors["Trustworthy"],
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = emo_stars %>% filter(emotion == e), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
              size = 3, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~metric_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "left") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.25, 0.75)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, labels = legend_mapping) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, labels = legend_mapping) +
    labs(x = "Value", y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = if (legend) "bottom" else "none",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
}

panels <- lapply(seq_along(EMOTIONS), function(i)
  emotion_panel(EMOTIONS[i], paste0(letters[i], ". ", EMOTIONS[i]), legend = i == 2))
p_combined <- wrap_plots(panels, ncol = length(EMOTIONS))
p_combined

ggsave(paste0("users/supersharers_emotion_comparison", ftag, ".png"),
       plot = p_combined, width = 6.5, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# save as pdf
ggsave(file.path(dst, "figures", paste0("supersharers_emotion_comparison", ftag, ".pdf")),
       plot = p_combined, width = 6.5, height = 5)
```
